Ethan (CS): Photonix renewal popped. Procurement is refusing to sign until invoice entity matches their VAT-registered name and they receive a signed third-party pen-test attestation. Also they want Net45 instead of our standard Net30.
Rosa (AE): Do they have a PO number yet? If they can provide PO+VAT ID we can map invoice. I can offer a one-time Net45 but need Finance sign-off.
Chris (Finance): Net45 OK for enterprise customers but require a credit review and billing contact. Also need beneficiary banking details and VAT ID on file.
Ethan (CS): Procurement asked for the billing entity to be "Photonix Europe Ltd" and signature by their UK CFO. They said the pen-test attestation must be vendor-signed PDF.
Miles (Legal): I can add an entity-mapping clause and Net45 payment terms to the amendment. Legal needs the vendor-signed attestation attached before e-sign. We can provisionally approve the amendment pending receipt of bank details and VAT docs.
Rosa (AE): I'll request PO# PX-EU-778 and the pen-test from their security lead. Also asking for the named billing contact: payables@photonix-eu.com.
DocuSignBot: Envelope EN-11357 created by Miles (Legal)  Amendment + billing-entity addendum awaiting signature "CFO - Photonix Europe Ltd"
Ethan (CS): Onboarding note: they also require SSO domain allowlist updated to *.photonix-eu.com and a routable webhook IP range. Tom (Onboard) can you confirm we can add allowlist entries before contract effective date?
Rosa (AE): Reminder: we have a 5-day discount window for the upsell. If docs come in within that window we can keep the agreed price. If not, revert to list pricing. I'll escalate to their procurement lead if no reply in 24h.
Chris (Finance): Sent credit checklist to payables@photonix-eu.com. Once VAT ID + bank details + PO received, billing will approve Net45.
Miles (Legal): I'll hold the envelope until pen-test PDF and VAT docs are attached. Please upload to the contract folder and reply here when done.
Ethan (CS): Thanks. I'll chase the security lead and procurement and update this thread with any artifacts.
